hardConstraints: 1. receipt stores only digest, refs, call index, version, and policy digest; never raw prompt, tool output, credentials, cookies, or environment values
2. append-only; same idempotency_key with identical content is idempotent success, different content must conflict-fail
3. no max(sequence)+1; use explicit attempt/model-call/wire-attempt identity
4. no silent pruning; deletion requires an explicit lifecycle policy
5. shadow write failure must not change send behavior but must fail RC-02 acceptance
6. receipt explains and correlates facts only; it never authorizes replay; domain journals remain the effect/idempotency truth source
7. npm fallback continues to report degraded and does not count toward complete receipt coverage

receiptOwnerDecision.selectedOwner: OpenClaw shared state SQLite / runtime_receipts via ReceiptStore
receiptOwnerDecision.reason: User-confirmed decision (2026-08-02). RC-01 completed the required comparison of existing domain journals, trajectory, TaskFlow/TaskRegistry evidence, RuntimeTaskEventLog, and a same-state-DB typed receipt table against receipt schema, atomic sequencing, retention, lookup, idempotency, failure propagation, privacy, and restart requirements. None of the existing owners qualifies: RuntimeTaskEventLog is default-off/prunable/without receipt kinds and stays diagnostic; TaskFlow flow_runs is workflow-scoped with in-process CAS; mission_events is mission-scoped; long_task_checkpoints is mutable checkpoint/resume truth that updates checkpoint_json under the same idempotency key and cannot cover ordinary model calls. The decision is to add a typed, append-only runtime_receipts table in the existing openclaw-state SQLite, exposed through a narrow ReceiptStore interface, reusing the shared state DB capabilities (schema, permissions, WAL, busy timeout, restart persistence, immediate transaction). No new database, sidecar, service, or second runtime authority is introduced. The seven hard constraints (digest-only payload, append-only with content-sensitive idempotency, explicit attempt/model-call/wire-attempt identity, no silent pruning, shadow-write failure fails RC-02 but never changes send behavior, receipt explains facts without authorizing replay, npm fallback stays degraded) are binding.
